name: ai-engineering-iphone-app
description: iOS application for AI Engineering Visualized

scripts.build:device: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination generic/platform=iOS -allowProvisioningUpdates -derivedDataPath build/derivedDataDevice build
scripts.deploy:device: npm run build:device && xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008120-00064D803CDB401E build/derivedDataDevice/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.launch:device: xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 00008120-00064D803CDB401E com.manikanta.aiengineering
